display_name: Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire (KCCQ): Physical Limitation Score
description:
Subscore for the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire (KCCQ) physical limitations domain. The subscore is based on a 5-point ordinal scale of 6 items and standardized to range from 0 to 100 with higher scores indicating better health status, fewer symptoms, and greater disease-specific health-related quality of life. [Green CP 2000 (PubMed ID: 10758967)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10758967/)

[Search for all KCCQ variables within this dataset](https://sleepdata.org/datasets/loft/variables?search=kccq)
